name: Platform-cloudflare-cron-triggers expression-router dispatcher
purpose: The dispatcher module realising the expression-routed dispatch shape per ADR-3302. Accepts an ordered map of {expression, handler} pairs, dispatches by exact cron-string match on the incoming Cron Trigger event, applies the skew-tolerance classification (TAC-3303 sink), applies the soft-budget observation (TAC-3303 sink) and delegates to the routed handler with a bounded context.
responsibilities: Match the incoming event.cron against routes[].expression by exact string equality; invoke the matched handler exactly once (AC-32102-1); on no match fire cronUnmatched and return (AC-32102-2).
Observe handler start against event.scheduledTime; classify onTime or skewed against skewToleranceMs (AC-32103-1, AC-32103-2); fire cronFired or cronSkewed as appropriate on the sink.
Observe handler duration; if it crosses softBudgetMs fire exactly one cronStalled on the sink at the crossing (AC-32104-1); NEVER terminate the handler (AC-32104-2).
Emit no event body bytes; the sink shape is metadata-only per TAC-3303 (AC-32106-1).
internalStructure: One module exporting createDispatcher({ routes, eventSink, skewToleranceMs, softBudgetMs, clock? }) returning { dispatch }. The dispatcher keeps a private clock (Date.now by default) so a fake clock injects for tests. The soft-budget observer schedules a setTimeout at softBudgetMs relative to the handler start; if the handler settles before the timeout, the timeout is cleared and only cronFired fires; if the timeout fires first, cronStalled emits and the handler continues to settlement, at which point cronFired follows.
